action.name: Copy Location
action.command: env -u LD_PRELOAD -u GTK_THEME sh -c 'for f; do echo "$f"; done | wl-copy -n' sh %F
action.description: Copy the full path(s) to the clipboard (needs wl-clipboard)

action.name: New File
action.description: Create an empty file in the current folder

action.name: Shred
action.command: env -u LD_PRELOAD -u GTK_THEME sh -c 'p=$PWD; for f; do shift; [ "$f" = "$p" ] || set -- "$@" "$f"; done; [ $# -gt 0 ] || { zenity --info --text="Select items to shred first."; exit 0; }; GTK_THEME=fm-sample "$HOME/.local/bin/fm-confirm" "Shred?" Shred || exit 0; if out=$(bleachbit --shred "$@" 2>&1); then zenity --info --title="Shred" --text="Done" --timeout=1; else zenity --error --title="Shred" --text="Shred failed:\n$out"; fi' sh %F
action.description: Overwrite and delete the selection with BleachBit (asks first)

action.name: New Folder
action.description: Create a folder in the current folder

action.name: Open in Terminal
action.description: Ptyxis in the folder; a selected executable runs there, any other file opens in nano

action.name: Rename
action.description: Open the selection in Thunar's bulk renamer

action.name: Extract
action.command: env -u LD_PRELOAD -u GTK_THEME sh -c 'for f; do case "$f" in *.tar.zst|*.tzst) b=$(basename "$f"); d=${b%.tar.zst}; d=${d%.tzst}; n=$d; i=1; while [ -e "$n" ]; do n="$d-$i"; i=$((i+1)); done; mkdir "$n" || continue; tar --zstd -xf "$f" -C "$n" || zenity --error --text="Could not extract $f";; *) unar -q -d "$f" || zenity --error --text="Could not extract $f";; esac; done' sh %F
action.description: Extract the archive into a folder named after it (unar; tar for .zst)

action.name: Compress...
action.description: Add the selection to a new archive (xarchiver; 7zip preselected, Cancel / Rename / Overwrite on a name clash)
